scope: Read-only aggregate inspection of an owner-supplied development snapshot using DuckDB 2.0.1 in an isolated Python environment. Product support is tracked separately.
owner_description: Mainland China historical stocks including delisted issuers. Counts below identify distinct source codes. Listing and delisting status were not independently verified.

minute_inventory.scope: Filenames and sizes were inventoried. The 2026 one-minute partition was checked for symbol shape.

comparison.method: Per selected date and file, group by the six-character code, counting rows and retaining the full qualified auction identifier. Count a candidate match only when each of the three groups contains exactly one row and the auction identifiers agree. Compare non-null factors by equality. Production matching also requires an attributable exchange for the daily instrument.

mapping_implications: Treat the bare code as a candidate key. Preserve the source spelling and venue, and require a verified venue association before combining instruments. The auction universe can include codes outside the daily file.

Keep the daily bar when either auction is missing. Preserve the original adj_factor and disclose the adjustment convention and anchor before deriving adjusted prices. All 1,448 null daily factors belonged to one code between 2000-07-19 and 2006-09-25.

The source documentation describes daily volume in lots, daily amount in ten-thousand yuan and minute amount in yuan. Auction volume and amount require their own unit verification. Treat the auction files as session observations at the granularity actually provided.

reproduction.reader: Use an isolated DuckDB 2.0.1 connection to the three files under root_setting. No application database or network connection is needed.
reproduction.summary_query: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT symbol), min(trade_date), max(trade_date), count(*) FILTER (WHERE adj_factor IS NULL) FROM read_parquet(?)
reproduction.join_check: Use the two anchor dates and the grouped-key comparison above. Perform the daily-to-auction completeness check with a left join; separately count auction keys absent from the daily file.

limits: These aggregates describe this snapshot and two join dates. Price accuracy, corporate actions, general cross-market identity, delisting classification, desktop import, subscriptions and Windows performance require independent verification.
